verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes implementation and acceptance rules for stable layout and predictable styles when legacy NXQ content is pasted into the new Word templates.
First concrete failure: the client reports major formatting and style problems when legacy content is moved into the new templates.
First concrete verification: the client executes the old-to-new document copy workflow and reports that the pasted content looks great; page-fit spacing is a separate behavior.
The freelancer prescribes stripping legacy formatting and reapplying new-template styles, leaving a material unresolved conflict with the client-requested direct paste-stability behavior.
